user.title: Solar Savings
user.description: Track solar energy used at home and the money it saved. Exported energy is never counted as savings.

data_description.name: Name of the device that holds the sensors.
data_description.solar_sensors: Cumulative energy sensors (kWh or Wh) for each solar source.
data_description.export_sensor: Optional. Cumulative energy sent to the grid. Without it, all production counts as used at home.
data_description.price_mode: What one kWh of solar used at home is worth.

fixed_price.title: Fixed price
fixed_price.description: The price you would have paid for grid energy.

data_description.price: In your Home Assistant currency per kWh.

price_entity.title: Price entity
price_entity.description: Energy is priced with the value of this entity at the moment it is measured.

data_description.price_entity: A sensor, input_number or number with the price per kWh. Units ending in /MWh or /Wh are converted.

error.no_solar: Pick at least one solar production sensor.
error.export_is_solar: The export sensor cannot also be a solar sensor.

init.title: Solar Savings options
init.description: Change sensors or the price. Totals so far are kept.
